renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Reality is got by trying hard, with care; its freedom is everywhere, never made. It does not move because wishing pushes it; but, but — from touching its own power, a person becomes like that. If you cannot see yourself and you want things done — when shaking stops, the highest place comes.

Then his natural state is unmade, marked by knowing and doing; all he wants, he knows and does. He looks at himself as boss, chilling as if — where would bad ways come from? Going from nothing to becoming, with no clear seeing there; but something touched, then it was sure.
So that made thing is known as always like deep sleep; but being only remembered is not what That gets.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Reality: earned by effort, with respect — its freedom is everywhere, unmanufactured. Not moving because wishing shoves it; but, but — touch your own power and you become that. Cannot see yourself, got errands — when shaking stops, top spot unlocks.

His nature then: unmade, knowing-doing branded; wants all, knows all, does all. Watching himself as boss, vibing as if — bad ways from where? Nothing-to-something, no clear seeing, but contact happened, then sure.
So that made thing reads as permanent deep-sleep mode; but That does not do being-merely-remembered.
